description: This file defines utility functions for managing notes, including creating blank notes, sorting notes by update time, filtering notes by query, and truncating text. It appears to be part of the frontend codebase for a notes management application.

methods.name: createBlankNote()
methods.description: Creates a new blank note object with default values including generated id and timestamps.

methods.name: sortNotesByUpdatedAt(notes)
methods.description: Sorts an array of notes in descending order based on their updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: filterNotes(notes, query)
methods.description: Filters an array of notes based on a case-insensitive query matched against title or content.

methods.name: truncate(text, max = 80)
methods.description: Shortens a text string to a specified maximum length, appending an ellipsis if truncated.
